title: Critique pass output (engage-forge Step 5)
description: Output of the mandatory critique pass. A named persona walks the recommended artefact and produces EXACTLY three friction points, each referencing a specific artefact element. The 'exactly 3' count is a deliberate design constraint — fewer understates the stress test; more dilutes prioritization.

selectionSource.description: How the persona was obtained — surfaced in the proposal so users can re-run with an explicit persona if the selected-from-problem choice was wrong.

frictionPoints.description: Exactly three friction points. minItems=3 + maxItems=3 enforces the 'exactly 3' contract.

artefactElement.description: Specific reference to the artefact element (e.g., 'Step 4 of the flow', 'Stage Evaluate', 'Feature: Order tracking'). Must be a non-empty string — friction points without a specific element reference are rejected.
